- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data (Bellwether blog, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026").
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (subscriber content): cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Cold-Chain 2026: Key Takeaways (Bellwether Blog + Companion)
